top_stories.title: CMR Green shares make strong D-Street debut, list at 43% premium over IPO price - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: The stock of **CMR Green Technologies**, an Indian non-ferrous metal recycler, opened at Rs 268 on the NSE, surging 40% from its IPO price. The company's IPO was subscribed 127.07 times overall, driven by strong demand from institutional investors.  **CMR Green Technologies** manufactures recycled aluminum alloys and other products used in automotive and industrial applications, with a customer base including major automobile manufacturers. The company has shown steady growth in recent years, reporting revenue of Rs 6,291 crore for the nine months ended December 2025 and net profit of Rs 162.39 crore.

top_stories.title: Utkal Speciality Industries IPO: Check GMP, price band, subscription and other details - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Utkal Speciality Industries**, a company that manufactures paper-based products and packaging materials, is set to list on the stock exchange with an entirely fresh issue of 52.34 lakh shares. The IPO allocation structure favors retail investors at 59.4%, while non-institutional investors receive 39.6% and qualified institutional buyers only 1%. **Affinity Global Capital Market** is the book-running lead manager, and **Cameo Corporate Services** acts as registrar.  The company plans to use proceeds for expansion and debt reduction, with Rs 11 crore allocated to prepayment of borrowings, Rs 9.6 crore for machinery purchases, and Rs 5.3 crore for working capital. The stock is scheduled to debut on June 17th.

top_stories.title: NLC India drops 3% even as gov OFS draws robust institutional demand; retail window opens today - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **NLC India**, a leading mining and power generation company in India, saw over 13.03 crore shares worth Rs 4,158 crore bid for during its initial public offering (IPO) oversubscription. The government aims to sell 2% of the company's equity capital, with an oversubscription option to sell an additional 1%.  **NLC India**, which is owned by the Central government and has a market capitalization of nearly Rs 44,303 crore, saw its share price fall around 8% in one week and 3% in one month.

top_stories.title: Donald Trump: Watch: Trump's 'proportional response' to Iran after helicopter attack - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Donald Trump** ordered retaliatory strikes against **Iran** after Tehran shot down a US Apache helicopter near the Strait of Hormuz. The **US Central Command (CENTCOM)** targeted Iranian air defense systems, ground control stations, and surveillance radar sites using precision-guided weapons.  **Iranian state media** reported that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) vowed a "decisive response" to the attacks. This escalation comes amid months of tensions in the Middle East following the US military campaign against **Iran**, known as Operation Epic Fury. The downing of the helicopter and subsequent strikes further strained a fragile ceasefire between **Iran** and Israel, which had been in place for two months.

top_stories.title: Jayshree Ullal: Meet Jayshree Ullal: The highest-ranked Indian-origin woman on America's Richest Self-Made Women list with a $6.8 billion fortune | World News - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Jayshree Ullal**, a former engineer and executive at **Cisco Systems**, became one of the wealthiest self-made women in the United States after leading networking startup **Arista Networks** to success.  She joined Arista in 2008, transforming it from a small startup into a major supplier of networking infrastructure used in cloud and AI data centers. Ullal's leadership has helped **Arista Networks** achieve significant growth and become a key beneficiary of the AI revolution. Her journey exemplifies how exceptional leadership and long-term value creation can lead to extraordinary wealth in the technology sector, making her one of the most influential figures in modern technology.

top_stories.title: Afcons Infra shares soar over 9% on Rs 5,301 cr order to build world’s second-largest breakwater - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Afcons Infra**, a marine infrastructure company, has been awarded a contract worth Rs 5,301 crore to construct a 10.14-km breakwater for the Vadhvan Port development in India. The project is expected to be the second-longest breakwater in the world upon completion and will significantly enhance India's port infrastructure. **Afcons** has extensive experience in marine projects globally, including the Bulk Jetty at Port of Sohar in Oman and the Sulphur Jetty project in Kuwait.  The company also reported a net loss in Q4 FY26 due to macroeconomic uncertainties and one-time factors.

top_stories.title: Lowe’s Promo Codes and Deals: Up to $300 Off Appliances | WIRED
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Lowe's**, a large home improvement retailer, offers various ways to save money on appliances, tools, and other products.  The company provides daily deals, promo codes, and rewards programs for customers. **Lowe's** also offers military discounts, free shipping, and a price guarantee policy. Customers can sign up for text alerts to receive coupons and exclusive deals.

top_stories.title: Pok Protests: Pakistan launches manhunt for four PoK protesters after crackdown killing 19 kids, 7 pregnant women - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Pakistan-occupied Kashmir (PoK)** authorities launched a search operation for four protesters and announced a bounty of Rs 1 crore for information leading to their arrest after massive protests in the region. **The crackdown**, which resulted in the death of 26 people, has been condemned by **India**, with the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) calling it a "pattern of fake news" and alleging excessive force used against civilians.  **Pakistan's security forces** have also been accused of targeting the **Joint Awami Action Committee (JAAC)**, which is campaigning for economic reforms, and banning it under anti-terrorism laws.

top_stories.title: Mackenzie Scott: Philanthropy queen: Jeff Bezos' ex-wife MacKenzie Scott's $26.4 billion donations earn her a prestigious Forbes honour | World News - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **MacKenzie Scott**, the former wife of **Jeff Bezos**, has been recognized by **Forbes** for her significant philanthropic contributions.  She has donated an estimated $26.4 billion in less than seven years, making it the largest annual charitable contribution by an individual since 2012. Her approach to philanthropy involves providing unrestricted grants to organizations, allowing them greater autonomy and flexibility in how they use the funds. Scott's donations have significantly benefited Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs), with institutions like Howard University and Prairie View A&M University receiving substantial support. This model of rapid giving has sparked discussion about trust-based philanthropy and its potential to address urgent challenges more effectively.

top_stories.title: FACT, Chambal Fertilisers shares up to 5% as government eyes doubling fertiliser subsidy allocation - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **The Ministry of Agriculture** has requested the **Finance Ministry** to double fertiliser subsidy allocation to Rs 1.71 lakh crore, citing escalating global fertilizer prices and import costs exacerbated by disruptions linked to the West Asia conflict. Officials warn that if these challenges persist, India's fertiliser subsidy bill could exceed Rs 3 lakh crore this fiscal year. While domestic production is improving, a shrinking global supply pool continues to drive up prices.  However, higher subsidy support and sustained demand optimism have attracted investor interest in the sector, with shares of **Fertilisers and Chemicals Travancore (FACT)** and **Chambal Fertilisers & Chemicals** surging on Wednesday.
